article.story: LOS ANGELES -- — Caleb Stone-Carrawell scored 19 and made two free throws with 44 seconds left to help Loyola Marymount hold off Santa Clara 57-54 on Thursday night. Stone-Carrawell shot 7 of 15 from the field and 4 for 4 from the line for the Lions (10-8, 2-4 West Coast Conference). Alex Merkviladze scored eight points and made two free throws with 25 seconds left for a three-point lead. Christoph Tilly finished with 25 points for the Broncos (12-7, 4-2). Adama Bal added 14 points and five assists. Stone-Carrawell put up 11 points in the first half for Loyola Marymount, which led 29-26 at halftime. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
